tasks.gr8-indigenous-technology-and-processing: Topic: Indigenous technology and processing. Cover preserving metals, galvanising, painting, electroplating, food preservation, local knowledge systems, and sustainability choices. Ask Grade 8 learners to compare methods, explain process purposes, and justify context-appropriate technology decisions.
tasks.gr8-systems-consolidation-and-exam-prepa: Topic: Systems consolidation and exam preparation. Cover integrated revision of mechanical, structural, and electrical vocabulary, mixed diagrams, design communication, and PAT reflection skills. Ask Grade 8 learners to interpret cross-system questions and choose concise, accurate exam responses.
